message.content:
The exact amount will depend on the current USD ↔ GBP exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent rates (mid‑2026), 1 USD is roughly **£0.78–£0.80**. Using that range:

| USD | Approx. GBP |
|-----|-------------|
| $20 | £15.60 – £16.00 |

So you can expect about **£15.5–£16** for $20. For the most accurate conversion at the time of your transaction, check a reliable currency‑converter website or your bank’s exchange rate.
